title: Filament load after a hotter material: old material pushed out at its own temperature (QIDI_Q2 #26)
note: The screen sends M604 T1 S<t> (push 80 mm) and M604 T2 S<t> (flush 80 mm) with the temperature of the filament set for the external spool; M603 S<t> unloads. The temperature of the material in the nozzle is kept in saved_variables.cfg (q2_fila_temp): set by a load, an unload, PRINT_START (HOTEND) and PRINT_END / CANCEL_PRINT (extruder target if >= 170). Heating and the push use max(new, old) (old capped at 350 C); the flush starts at the new temperature without waiting for the nozzle to cool. With nothing hotter remembered every step is as in QIDI's macro. QIDI Box tool changes inside a print are QIDI's closed code and not changed.
